column1: # The texts of Seasons whose translation is not the European text of the same identifier (engine/language/language.h).
# Every other US text takes the European text of its identifier, when its commands are the US text's.
# The first row pins the European ROM the table was measured on, by its SHA-1. A row then: the texts (TX_GGII, four
# hexadecimal digits each, or a range first-last, space-separated), the languages (en-eu, fr, de, it, es,
# comma-separated, or all: the five of the European ROM), the source of their translation, and why. A source is one of:
#   eu:TX_GGII   the European text of that identifier: the European ROM moved the text there
#   rule:NAME    the European text of the same identifier, adapted to the US code by a rule (language_rules.c)
#   own:KEY      the port's own translation, unofficial (config/language_own.tsv)
